title: Exact single-object computation of the canonical derived unit
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with chosen unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the monoidal, countable exact-colimit, tensor-compatibility and functorial-flat-resolution hypotheses under which the library defines its total left-derived functor on C, and K-injective resolutions on D. Let f:C→D and g:D→C be exact additive adjoints. For X in C, Y in D and c:f(X)→Y, use the named construction [def-asd-derived-single-unit], namely the unit of the existing full adjunction Lf ⊣ Rg at X[0], followed by Rg of the canonical single-object comparison Lf(X[0])→f(X)[0] and c[0]. Composing this with the exact right-single comparison Rg(Y[0])→g(Y)[0] equals (adj.homEquiv(c))[0]. This is equality of the actual normalized morphisms in the unbounded derived category.

proof.text: Compute the homotopy adjunction unit on a complex concentrated in degree zero, using the termwise unit. In degree zero the two single-comparison maps are identities; all other components have zero source. Descend the resulting equality through the homotopy quotient and derived localization.

Apply the published unit factorization for the levelwise derived adjunction to the termwise homotopy adjunction. The preceding single-complex calculation and cancellation of the exact localization comparisons give the underived single unit. Transport through the canonical left-derived and right-derived exact comparison isomorphisms, whose defining factorizations identify their units. Naturality of the right single comparison moves the arbitrary c past it, giving the single image of the underived adjunct.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedSingleUnit_comp_comparison (adj : f ⊣ g) (X : C) (Y : D)
    (c : f.obj X ⟶ Y) :
    derivedSingleUnit adj X Y c ≫
      g.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso.hom.app Y =
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).map (adj.homEquiv X Y c)
